content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-321. - Tax information to be confidential.
content.summary:
Subject to any limitation of a judicial order, the finance director or any other officer
               or employee of the city shall not divulge any information regarding any admissions
               tax report or return filed with the city as required by any provision of this article.
